claim_en: LO TISA AS THREE AZHAROT AND A WITNESS FILTER: the slander-receiver, the judge hearing one side alone, the litigant pleading alone; the judge's oath needs amen (Abba Chanan); refusing the split-a-false-witness offer; the violent and robbers disqualified as witnesses (R. Natan).

check.note: Three warned parties on one clause plus the witness-fitness rule.

claim_en: ASYMMETRIC MAJORITY RULE: with-them for good not for evil — 12-11 acquits, conviction needs a margin of two ('as witnesses are two, the tilters are two'); the I-don't-know judge tilts to acquittal. Onkelos EXPANDS the crux into the rulings: 'do not refrain from teaching what you see; AFTER THE MANY THE JUDGMENT IS COMPLETED.'

check.note: The majority principle with its acquittal bias, printed inside the received translation.

source: Mekhilta on Exod 23:5; Mekhilta on Exod 23:4; Onkelos Exod 23:5
claim_en: THE RIS MEASURE AND THE GRUDGE RELEASED. See/encounter reconciled by a MINTED NUMBER — one in seven-and-a-half of a mil; unloading and loading both Torah; the priority cases (the father's contrary order NOT obeyed — parents themselves bound; Israel's donkey vs the gentile's load); 'azov ta'azov' read twice — unload the beast AND leave what is in your heart against him (Onkelos carries the grudge-release inside the translation); the who-is-the-enemy dispute (R. Natan: your own son after a quarrel — an enemy for the hour); 'with him' — the idle owner exempts you.

check.note: A number coined between two verses; a moral release encoded in the Aramaic.

claim_en: THE ACQUITTAL ASYMMETRY AND THE CIRCUMSTANTIAL REFUSAL. Left guilty and merit found — retried; left acquitted and guilt found — NOT retried ('for I will not acquit the wicked' — the reversal is Heaven's); Onkelos renders it as the verse ('one who went out ACQUITTED from the court you shall not kill'); single witnesses to different acts do not join; THE PURSUER WARNING QUOTES GEN 9:6 as the operative statute (G21-13's Mekhilta seat is this unit's ink); the dripping-knife case refuses circumstantial conviction (the Shimon b. Shetach narratives); bench rules (no ignorant colleague, no advocates, the heresy azharah); bribery absolute even to judge truly, with the blindness ladder.

check.note: Double-jeopardy asymmetry, evidence law, and a Genesis statute quoted live in this unit's court.

claim_en: THE SEVENTH YEAR'S ABANDONMENT IS LAWLESS BY DESIGN: do not gather-and-distribute — the Torah says breach it with breaches; the sages' fence recorded AS a fence (tikkun olam); cross-year produce is seventh-year produce both directions; rich/poor phases around the removal-hour; the beast-hekesh suspends tithing.

check.note: A statute whose stated design is open access, with the rabbinic fence kept distinct.

claim_en: ANIMAL REST DEFINED AS GRAZING FREEDOM — confinement 'is not rest but suffering'; Shabbat restated inside the year-laws so creation's Shabbat is not displaced; the handmaid's son = the uncircumcised slave, the sojourner = the resident alien; the border-status table (resident alien on Shabbat as Israel on a festival; uncircumcised slaves as Israel on festival weekdays; R. Akiva switches).

check.note: Rest defined against its counterfeit; two liminal statuses fixed.

claim_en: THE APPEARANCE-EXEMPTION TABLE WORD BY WORD: shall-appear excludes the blind, regalim the lame, your-males women, ALL-your-males the tumtum and androgynos, the recital's in-their-ears the deaf, rejoicing the sick and old, before-the-LORD the impure — 'all are obligated in appearing except...'; not-empty-handed = the appearance offerings ('shall your table be full and your Master's empty?'); the aviv anchor; 'the Master' — His name on Israel especially.

check.note: A tractate's exemption list read off single tokens of this unit.

source: Mekhilta on Exod 23:19; Onkelos Exod 23:19; Mekhilta on Exod 23:18; Onkelos Exod 23:18
claim_en: THE KID-SENTENCE IS A COMPRESSED STATUTE AND THE TRANSLATION PRINTS ITS CONCLUSION. The three-tokens question with SEVEN recorded answers; the eating ban derived up the pesach-sinew-carcass ladder, the benefit ban up the orlah-chametz-vineyard ladder (Rebbi's sell-not-cook); the kid as the abundant ordinary case; Onkelos renders the verse 'YOU SHALL NOT EAT MEAT IN MILK.' The pesach-and-leaven clause: no slaughtering (R. Akiva adds throwing) while leaven stands; zivchi = MY PASSOVER in the Aramaic; the fats' altar-pavement/pyre lodging rule. Bikkurim: the bring-but-not-read classes; the sanctuary-house pointing.

check.note: A whole derivation chain whose bottom line is the received translation of the verse.

source: Mishnah Bikkurim 1:2/1:3/1:9; Mishnah Challah 4:10; Mekhilta on Exod 23:19
claim_en: THREE FIRSTFRUITS LEGS (F-018): not before Shavuot (the Tzevoim refusal on 23:16's own words); responsibility until the Temple Mount (the bring-verb); and the grower-classes DELTA dual-track (Mekhilta bring-but-not-read vs Mishnah do-not-bring, one clause two seats).
